form:FormGroup.label: Element Id
form:FormGroup.helpText: The ID of the pipeline element that this reference data lookup belongs to.

form:FormGroup.label: Pipeline
form:FormGroup.helpText: The reference loader pipeline that loads the reference data. A Plan B store can also be chosen here for state lookups.

form:FormGroup.label: Feed
form:FormGroup.helpText: The feed that holds the reference data streams.

form:FormGroup.label: Stream Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The stream type to load reference data from. Default is Reference. Choose Context to use the context data of the stream being processed.
